labels.name: spec-approved
labels.description: The owner approved this spec: its tickets may be cut and built

labels.name: owner-merge
labels.description: High-risk: this issue's PRs, or all tickets of this spec, count as high-risk (agents may queue them)

labels.name: owner-only
labels.description: Only the owner merges this issue's PRs, or all tickets of this spec (legal, money, agent rules)

labels.name: run-native
labels.description: Run the iOS and Android CI jobs on this PR, whatever changed (read on its pushes)

labels.name: prio-high
labels.description: Owner task: do first; it blocks agent work soon or has a long wait (a sign-up, a reply)

labels.name: prio-medium
labels.description: Owner task: due before the next gate (G0 or G2); not blocking agents yet

labels.name: prio-low
labels.description: Owner task: for go-live (G4) or later, or blocked by another issue

labels.name: effort-quick
labels.description: Owner task: 15 minutes or less, on your own

labels.name: effort-medium
labels.description: Owner task: up to an hour on your own, or one message and wait for the reply

labels.name: effort-big
labels.description: Owner task: a meeting with someone else, or several steps over days

labels.name: with-pilot-gym
labels.description: Owner task: done with the pilot gym owner; batch these into one visit
